input.command:
python3 -I -c '
import subprocess, sys, json
cmd = [sys.executable, ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"]
for f in ("input.md","output.md"):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd+["audit",f,"--level","3","--scope=format","--json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    d = json.loads(p.stdout)
    print("==", f, "exit", p.returncode)
    print("schema", d.get("schema_version"))
    print("score", json.dumps(d.get("score",{}), ensure_ascii=False)[:600])
    print("findings:", json.dumps(d.get("findings"), ensure_ascii=False))
    print("shown:", json.dumps(d.get("shown_findings"), ensure_ascii=False))
    print("coverage:", json.dumps(d.get("coverage"), ensure_ascii=False)[:900])
    print()
'
input.description: Dump audit JSON for both files

input.command:
python3 -I -c '
import subprocess, sys
cmd = [sys.executable, ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"]
runs = [
  ["audit","input.md","--level","3","--scope=format"],
  ["audit","output.md","--level","3","--scope=format"],
  ["fmt","--check","output.md"],
  ["verify","input.md","output.md","--scope=format"],
  ["report","input.md","output.md","--scope=format","--level","3"],
]
for args in runs:
    p = subprocess.run(cmd+args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("$", " ".join(args), "-> exit", p.returncode)
    if p.stderr.strip(): print("   stderr:", p.stderr.strip()[:300])
'
